remarks: Welcome to a beautifully remodeled, move-in-ready townhouse-style residence in the heart of Glendale. Come home to this warm 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom, contemporary-style residence with meaningful recent upgrades of $80,000. MAJOR VALUE- 2.5% Financing until May 2028 for Eligible Buyers to assume the existing 7-year ARM. Inside, there is an open-concept living and dining area, sleek finishes, recessed lighting, elegant crown molding, decorative details, and a cozy fireplace. The first floor features updated tile flooring completed in 2023, creating a clean, modern look that is both stylish and easy to maintain.
